subject: round e2 (after ear_lit, EAR_LIT 1.0), ear_e2.png
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 (MHS3) anime toon style, male protagonist

ear_lighting.reference: the ear reads as lit warm peach skin; only the bowl in the middle and a thin band at the front edge are darker
ear_lighting.ours: the top of the ear inside the rim is now lit light peach and there is a light patch low on the back; the middle, the front and most of the lower ear are still flat warm-brown shadow, about two thirds of the ear

inner_line.reference: a thin dark-brown painted line follows the inner side of the rim from the top down the back, ending above the lobe, like the letter C
inner_line.ours: no line inside the ear; the inside of the rim has no drawn mark

concha.reference: the bowl in the middle of the ear is a clear darker shape in a mauve, pinkish-brown colour, taller than wide, covering about the middle third of the ear
concha.ours: the bowl in the middle of the ear is not visible as its own shape; it is the same warm-brown shadow colour as the rest of the ear

rim_highlight.reference: the outer rim (helix) is a light peach band along the top and back of the ear
rim_highlight.ours: a light peach band along the top of the rim and a thin light strip down the back edge

shape_ratio.reference: a tall narrow C shape; width about 0.39 of its height (measured on the board), broadest at the top, narrow lobe
shape_ratio.ours: a tall oval; width about 0.46 of its height (measured on the board), broadest at the top, narrow lobe

size_position.reference: the top of the ear is level with the brows and the lobe is level with the bottom of the nose
size_position.ours: the top of the ear is level with the brows and the lobe is level with the bottom of the nose

outline.reference: a dark-brown outline around the ear, about as thick as the face outline
outline.ours: a dark-brown outline around the ear, about as thick as the face outline

stand_off.reference: the ear sits close to the side of the head, seen almost from the side, its back edge only slightly away from the skull
stand_off.ours: the ear stands out from the side of the head, seen almost from the side, its back edge slightly away from the skull
